newsitem.title: USA: American Residential Q3 better than expected.
newsitem.headline: American Residential Q3 better than expected.

text.p: American Residential Services Inc said Tuesday its third quarter results were "slightly above" its expectations of $0.14 per share.
For that period, the company reported pro forma net income of $0.16 per share.

The company said that prior to its September initial public offering, management had begun integrating the companies that make up American Residential Services. It said the benefits were slightly offset by increases in corporate overhead expenses.
American Residential primarily provides maintenance, repair, replacement and new equipment installation services for heating, air conditioning, plumbing and electrical for residential customers.
